implementation.journal: Separate BAIQI_RELIGIOUS_INTENTS_V1, strict bounded metadata, fresh Core persisted ARMED acknowledgement before sole UI RequestOperation.

implementation.last_charge: Disappearance without charge proof remains unknown, never fabricated OBSERVED. No segment-event completion is assumed.
implementation.manual_boundary: Missionary added to explicit UI guard whitelist; apostle/inquisitor/guru excluded and remain native.
